[[Reng Ku]] wants you to eliminate the [[mantid]] nest inside [[Zhengjo Temple]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Necromancer
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
*Travel through the Zhengjo Temple and eliminate the [[mantid]]s. 
*Kill the [[Queen Mantid|queen mantid]].
*See Reng Ku for your reward

===Early benefits===
*On accepting the quest, Reng Ku gives you the following skills:
**{{skill icon|Animate Bone Fiend}}
**{{skill icon|Faintheartedness}}

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
The entrance to the temple is east from Reng Ku's location. Inside there will be two mantids. Killing a mantid will cause another to spawn. After five mantids have been killed, the Queen Mantid will drop down. Kill it and return to Reng Ku for your reward.

==NPCs==
[[Mantid]]s
*{{mo}} 1 (22) [[Mantid (monk)|Mantid]]
*{{mo}} 3 (22) [[Queen Mantid]]
*{{n}} 2 (22) [[Mantid (necromancer)|Mantid]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Reng Ku
''This task will test your ability to utilize minions effectively, not that it really matters in the grand scheme of things.... Anyway, the nearby temple has been infested with [[mantid]]s that should prove a fairly simple task for you. Their [[Queen Mantid|queen mother]], however, might be a different story. Eliminate the nest and return to me.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I think I can handle a few mantids.
| decline = No thanks. This sounds like a lesson I can live without.
| ask = Look, I do not honestly care what you do, but if you wish to graduate, get inside and get busy. Return to me when you have killed all the [[mantid]]s and their [[Queen Mantid|queen]].
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Reng Ku
:''Are you finally finished? I was about to give up and head back to the monastery.''

==Notes==
{{bug|If this quest is accepted while the Festival Event Quest [[A Strange Request]] is active, the quest marker will not appear in the minimap and progress will be halted. Finish or abandon the Festival Event Quest first prior to attempting this quest.}}
